findings.summary: The credential comparison now validates UTF-8 byte lengths before timingSafeEqual, avoiding an exception for unequal non-ASCII inputs.
Firmware cargo check remains blocked by an existing missing local src/secrets.rs module, before the modified path can compile.

verified_invariants: PWA source no longer holds the shared ESP registration credential
Functions bind the required Secret Manager parameter and fail closed when unavailable
Firmware requests fail closed if the build-time credential is absent
The existing us-central1 endpoint placement is unchanged
required_before_preview_or_production: Human sets a newly generated secret immediately before an approved Function deployment
Authorized firmware build receives the same value without committing or printing it
Firmware builds and hardware registration are verified
Old shared credential is retired after successful migration
